items.title: Trump’s pause on Russia sanctions is ‘reward’ for Putin, Zelenskyy says

sentences.en: Trump’s pause on Russia sanctions is ‘reward’ for Putin, Zelenskyy says.
sentences.zh: 泽伦斯基说，特朗普暂停对俄罗斯的制裁是对普京的“奖励”。

sentences.en: Ukrainian president warns it will embolden Russian leader and intensify war as Moscow hits country’s power plants Power plant attacks reflect Russian blueprint to make Ukrainian cities unlivable Volodymyr Zelenskyy has described Donald Trump’s decision to roll back sanctions on Russia as a “reward” for Vladimir Putin and warned it will embolden the Russian leader and intensify the Kremlin’s war, as Moscow launched one of its worst strikes yet on Ukraine’s power plants in an attempt to black out the country’s cities before winter.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰总统警告说，随着莫斯科袭击该国的发电厂，这将使俄罗斯领导人更加胆大妄为，并加剧战争。发电厂的袭击反映了俄罗斯让乌克兰城市不适宜居住的蓝图。沃洛季米尔·泽伦斯基（ Volodymyr Zelenskyy ）将唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）决定取消对俄罗斯的制裁描述为对弗拉基米尔·普京（ Vladimir Putin ）的“奖励” ，并警告说，这将使俄罗斯领导人更加胆大妄为，并加剧克里姆林宫的战争，因为莫斯科对乌克兰的发电厂发动了迄今为止最严重的袭击之一，试图熄火。

sentences.en: The Ukrainian president also said he expected the Trump administration to lift more sanctions against Russia in the future and called for Europe to establish its own negotiations with Moscow as the US has sought better ties and business deals with the Kremlin.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰总统还表示，他预计特朗普政府将在未来取消对俄罗斯的更多制裁，并呼吁欧洲与莫斯科建立自己的谈判，因为美国已寻求与克里姆林宫建立更好的关系和商业交易。

sentences.zh: 种族隔离结束30多年后，南非过去一些最严重罪行的受害者家属仍在为正义而战。

sentences.en: Australian ​brothers Jake ​and Callum Robinson, and ​their ‌American friend Carter Rhoad, were killed while on a surf trip in Baja California in 2024 Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A Mexican ⁠judge ⁠has sentenced ​three men to 158 years ⁠and nine months in prison each for ⁠the murder of ​two Australian ‌brothers ‌and their American friend during ‌a 2024 surf trip to the state of Baja California.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚兄弟Jake和Callum Robinson以及他们的美国朋友Carter Rhoad于2024年在下加利福尼亚州的冲浪之旅中被杀害。获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客。一名墨西哥法官因在2024年下加利福尼亚州的冲浪之旅中谋杀两名澳大利亚兄弟和他们的美国朋友而判处三名男子158年监禁和九个月监禁。

sentences.en: The ‌defendants were declared guilty a week ​ago of homicide, aggravated robbery, robbery with violence and vehicle theft ⁠with violence, crimes committed against ​Australian ​brothers Jake ​and Callum Robinson, and ​their ‌American friend ​Carter Rhoad.
sentences.zh: 一周前，被告被宣布犯有杀人罪、严重抢劫罪、暴力抢劫罪和暴力车辆盗窃罪，以及针对澳大利亚兄弟Jake和Callum Robinson以及他们的美国朋友Carter Rhoad的罪行。

items.title: Mimicking populists will not ease cost of living or boost productivity, Mathias Cormann warns

sentences.en: Mimicking populists will not ease cost of living or boost productivity, Mathias Cormann warns.
sentences.zh: Mathias Cormann警告说，模仿民粹主义者不会降低生活成本或提高生产力。

sentences.en: Former minister and OECD head urges Australia not to adopt migration caps, with research showing migrants boost employment Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australia’s mainstream political parties are being warned not to adopt populist policies such as migration caps to address voters’ grievances over the cost of living.
sentences.zh: 前部长和经合组织负责人敦促澳大利亚不要采用移民上限，研究表明移民可以促进就业。我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客警告澳大利亚主流政党不要采取民粹主义政策，如移民上限，以解决选民对生活费用的不满。

sentences.en: Instead, Australia’s longest-serving finance minister, Mathias Cormann, is urging politicians to deliver housing, real wage growth and lower energy costs by boosting productivity.
sentences.zh: 相反，澳大利亚任期最长的财政部长马蒂亚斯·科尔曼（ Mathias Cormann ）正在敦促政界人士通过提高生产力来提供住房、实际工资增长和降低能源成本。

items.title: Brazilian Amazon deforestation falls to lowest on record as pivotal vote looms

sentences.en: Brazilian Amazon deforestation falls to lowest on record as pivotal vote looms.

sentences.en: Forest clearance at smallest total since records began in 1988 in success for Lula ahead of presidential run-off Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon has fallen to its lowest level since records began, new government data shows.
sentences.zh: 新的政府数据显示，自1988年记录开始以来，卢拉在巴西亚马逊地区总统决选森林砍伐之前的成功森林清理总量已降至记录开始以来的最低水平。

sentences.en: But whether this globally important success is maintained or reversed is on a knife edge ahead of a presidential election run-off on 25 October between two candidates with sharply different visions for the future of the rainforest and how that affects relations with the US under Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 但是，在10月25日两位对热带雨林的未来有着截然不同愿景的候选人之间的总统选举决选之前，这一具有全球重要意义的成功是保持还是逆转，以及这如何影响唐纳德特朗普领导下的与美国的关系。

items.title: Brazil’s Lula says he now backs lowering age of criminal responsibility to 16

sentences.en: Brazil’s Lula says he now backs lowering age of criminal responsibility to 16.
sentences.zh: 巴西的卢拉说，他现在支持将刑事责任年龄降至16岁。

sentences.en: Lula reverses position on age of responsibility for ‘heinous’ crimes in what many see as a desperate electoral gambit Brazil’s president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, has announced that he now supports lowering the age of criminal responsibility for “heinous” crimes from 18 to 16, reversing a longstanding policy in what is widely seen as a desperate electoral gambit.
sentences.zh: 卢拉改变了对“令人发指”罪行责任年龄的立场，许多人认为这是绝望的选举策略巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ）宣布，他现在支持将“令人发指”罪行的刑事责任年龄从18岁降至16岁，从而扭转了长期以来被广泛视为绝望的选举策略的政策。

sentences.en: The U-turn, which Lula announced during a Thursday night interview with TV Globo, comes with the presidential runoff in just over a week.
sentences.zh: 卢拉在周四晚间接受环球电视台采访时宣布的转机，伴随着一周多的总统决选。

sentences.en: The incumbent faces an uphill battle to overturn the first-round victory of his opponent, the far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who remains slightly ahead at the polls.
sentences.zh: 现任总统面临着一场艰苦的战斗，以推翻他的对手，极右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ FlávioBolsonaro ）的第一轮胜利，他在民意调查中仍然略有领先。
